## Biography

The Teal Nebula appears in the Distant Worlds 3 expedition records as a waypoint — a cloud of ionised gas in the region between the Bubble and the deeper frontier, notable for its unusual colouration and its position along surveyed deep-space routes.

For the expedition, it was another marker in a journey of thousands. For the pilots who passed through, it was a reminder that the galaxy's beauty persists even in the most functional moments of exploration. The nebula's teal colour comes from oxygen emission lines — the same chemical signature that makes Earth's sky blue, translated across light-years into a cloud of glowing gas.

Some waypoints are chosen for fuel. Some for shelter. Some, like the Teal Nebula, are chosen because the human eye needs occasional proof that the universe is not entirely hostile.
